text:
devin: @eval-bot generated nightly eval alert for model redwood-open-13b-int4-try1. 11 promptsets failed out of 124. top two hitters: `legal-snippet` (blank / redacted outputs) and `longcontext-punctuate` (punctuation-only replies). full summary below.

eval-bot: ```
model: redwood-open-13b-int4-try1
suite: nightly-eval-v2
failed_promptsets: 11
severity_breakdown: high=1(mostly legal-snippet), medium=3, low=7
median_latency: 120ms (unchanged)
notable_diff: increased blank/short outputs for cohorts with long contexts and legal snippets
probable-change: recent quantization kernel update + small-batch fallback last night
```

maria: taking ownership for initial triage. assigning aj + eng-runtime for kernel/kv-cache check.

aj: on it. will run a focused canary with float32 vs int4 for the legal cohort. starting with batch_size=1, kvcache=true.

sam: flagging that dedicated rollout included a new qkernel build at 03:12 UTC. logs show a couple of small-batch fallbacks around 03:30. cc @eng-runtime.

nate: quick hypothesis: int4 path dropping leading tokens for long-context prompts due to a prefix-serializer change. could produce punctuation-only or empty outputs if stop token logic sees empty generation.

luis: I can repro locally with the eval runner. repro command: ```bash
./eval_runner --model redwood-open-13b-int4-try1 --cohort cohorts/legal-snippet.json --batch 1 --kvcache yes --seed 42 --out debug.json
```

aj: ran repro against float32 and int4. float32 -> expected answers. int4 -> many outputs = "\n" or "." or extremely short truncations. saving diff to s3://redwood-debug/5500004321/int4-diffs.tar.gz

maria: good, consistent repro. next steps: 1) roll back qkernel build to previous release on a small canary (1 host) 2) add extra logging around prefix length and stop-token behavior 3) run canary against hosted traffic slice.

sam: rollback plan looks safe. I'll coordinate with eng-releases to cut canary.

aj: quick check of the quant config: we used per-channel symmetric quant with a new clipping op. toggling clipping off in local run fixes the blanking. suspect clipping + kvcache serializer interaction.

nate: adding `eng-runtime` as an explicit owner for the kernel fix patch. if clipping was introduced in the compiler/kernel, we need a unit test for long-context retention.

maria: severity = P1 for customer-impact cohort (legal). alerting Customer Success for any customers on dedicated instances. tagging product-security for possible redaction issues.

luis: I'll prepare a small promptset to test edge cases: extremely long preambles + stop tokens + legal redaction heuristics. putting it under `cohorts/smoke/legal-longprefix.json`.

devin: timeline: canary rollback in next 30m. if green, promote rollback 2h. if failure persists after rollback, we hotfix kernel.

aj: posting quick reproducer link and raw diffs: https://internal.redwood/s/5500004321/int4-diffs

maria: assigning follow-ups: (maria) triage owner, (aj) repro + canary validate, (sam) rollback coord, (nate) kernel fix owner, (luis) craft edge-case promptset. will update here after canary results. :thumbsup:

devin: thanks team. keeping this channel for updates. if anything blocks, escalate to #eng-oncall.
